subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the final rebased set of 14 executable GitHub Action revisions in its credential-bearing and publishing workflows?
rationale: Automated review can verify pin shape and upstream contracts, but it cannot authorize new third-party executable bundles to receive repository tokens, private keys, registry credentials, and OpenAI credentials.

options.title: Audit and approve final pins
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, review each resulting immutable revision and privileged workflow, and approve the exact head after required checks settle.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token-generation, Docker publishing, and CodeQL changes into smaller PRs so each security boundary can be audited independently.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Close or postpone this grouped bump if the final dependency set cannot be refreshed and reviewed safely.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve final pins
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, review each resulting immutable revision and privileged workflow, and approve the exact head after required checks settle.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected surface spans central CI, release publishing, security scanning, and agent automation, and repository history connects this owner to recent release-workflow hardening.
